report:
## Round 4 — Authorization headers with any scheme are redacted

- **Theme (P1):** the redaction safety net knew only `Bearer` and `Basic`, so `Authorization: Token …`, `ApiKey …`, `Digest …`, `OAuth …` and a bare opaque value crossed every text surface (`src/history.ts`, `src/gate.ts`, `src/records.ts`, `src/memory/archive.ts`) verbatim; `authorization` appeared only in `isSensitiveKey`, which the text surfaces never see.
- **Change:** one new rule `authorization-other-scheme` in `src/redact.ts`, placed after `authorization-bearer` and `authorization-basic` so those still own their own output. It redacts the header value for any other scheme and for a bare value, keeps the header name, and covers the JSON key form (`{"authorization":"Token …"}`) that the Basic rule already covers for its own scheme. Benign values (`Authorization: none`, `Authorization: required`), the `[REDACTED]` placeholder and prose about the header are left alone. No existing rule was deleted, reordered or weakened; the Bearer/Basic patterns are unchanged.
- **Files:** `src/redact.ts` (one rule), `test/redact.spec.ts` (one new case, plus one parity-corpus line so the generated-script mirror of the new rule is exercised; 25 cases in the file), `.rsi/evidence/round-004/red.txt`, `.rsi/evidence/round-004/green.txt`.
- **Evidence:** `.rsi/evidence/round-004/red.txt`, `green.txt`, `ci.txt` ({{CI}}), `git.txt`
- **Unverified:** `npm run ci` itself is `NOT_RUN` here — it runs `npm run build`, which rewrites `lib/`, and this round is not allowed to touch `lib/`; {{CI}} above is the summary finish-round actually runs. `npx vitest run test/redact.spec.ts` (red: 1 failed / 24 passed; green: 25 passed), `npm run test:unit` (18 files / 427 tests passed) and `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` were run in `.worktrees/rsi-r4`. A value shorter than 6 characters still passes through, e.g. `Authorization: Token abcd` — the floor is the one the other bare-value rules use to leave prose alone, and the four audited shapes are all longer. No real DSH runtime check was run; this change is a text pattern only, and no runtime path was claimed.
- **Suggested version:** patch → `0.11.4` ({{TAG}}).
- **status:** OK

commit_message:
fix(redact): redact Authorization headers with any scheme

The rule list only knew `Bearer` and `Basic`, so `Authorization: Token …`,
`ApiKey …`, `Digest …`, `OAuth …` and a bare opaque value passed through the
redaction safety net verbatim into report bodies, history text, gate answers,
records and memory archives. `authorization` was only known to `isSensitiveKey`,
which the text surfaces never consult.

Add one rule, `authorization-other-scheme`, after the Bearer/Basic rules so
those keep their own output: it redacts the header value for any other scheme
and for a scheme-less value, keeps the header name so the line still says what
leaked, and covers the JSON key form. Benign values (`Authorization: none`,
`Authorization: required`), the `[REDACTED]` placeholder and prose about the
header are left untouched. No existing rule or test was weakened.

Evidence: .rsi/evidence/round-004/red.txt (1 failed / 24 passed),
green.txt (25 passed), targeted `npx vitest run test/redact.spec.ts`.
